meta.title: Teachers and Students
meta.description: The bullet cases fall to the ground, the clatter reminiscent of the past.

units.rawText: In the temporary tactical command center, Krasno.
units.displayText: In the temporary tactical command center, Krasno.

spans.text: In the temporary tactical command center, Krasno.

units.rawText: The training camp is over and both platoons have been disbanded. Another unit will come to take over your campsite by noon tomorrow.
units.displayText: The training camp is over and both platoons have been disbanded. Another unit will come to take over your campsite by noon tomorrow.

spans.text: The training camp is over and both platoons have been disbanded. Another unit will come to take over your campsite by noon tomorrow.

units.rawText: Understood, sir!
units.displayText: Understood, sir!

spans.text: Understood, sir!

units.rawText: Python responds reflexively, then he falls silent for a while.
units.displayText: Python responds reflexively, then he falls silent for a while.

spans.text: Python responds reflexively, then he falls silent for a while.

units.rawText: So this is the conclusion that HQ has reached?
units.displayText: So this is the conclusion that HQ has reached?

spans.text: So this is the conclusion that HQ has reached?

units.rawText: I understand your dissatisfaction with the situation, Python. I witnessed the entire ambush. So has the entire Committee, for that matter.
units.displayText: I understand your dissatisfaction with the situation, Python. I witnessed the entire ambush. So has the entire Committee, for that matter.

spans.text: I understand your dissatisfaction with the situation, Python. I witnessed the entire ambush. So has the entire Committee, for that matter.

units.rawText: And based on what happened, you surmise that this path isn't workable? Erwin and Evelyn have a lot of potential, I hope you'll give them a...
units.displayText: And based on what happened, you surmise that this path isn't workable? Erwin and Evelyn have a lot of potential, I hope you'll give them a...

spans.text: And based on what happened, you surmise that this path isn't workable? Erwin and Evelyn have a lot of potential, I hope you'll give them a...

units.rawText: Many things show potential, Python. In the labs, among the general staff, they're everywhere. Just like the Balmung from this exercise. You halted that project, which is a credit to you.
units.displayText: Many things show potential, Python. In the labs, among the general staff, they're everywhere. Just like the Balmung from this exercise. You halted that project, which is a credit to you.

spans.text: Many things show potential, Python. In the labs, among the general staff, they're everywhere. Just like the Balmung from this exercise. You halted that project, which is a credit to you.

units.rawText: What we need is something that can realize that potential. Mixed deployments have their possibilities, but that's all.
units.displayText: What we need is something that can realize that potential. Mixed deployments have their possibilities, but that's all.

spans.text: What we need is something that can realize that potential. Mixed deployments have their possibilities, but that's all.

units.rawText: Your mission is over, "Instructor Python." The training camp on the East Bank needs you. Take two days to rest and head out.
units.displayText: Your mission is over, "Instructor Python." The training camp on the East Bank needs you. Take two days to rest and head out.

spans.text: Your mission is over, "Instructor Python." The training camp on the East Bank needs you. Take two days to rest and head out.

units.rawText: ...Yes, sir!
units.displayText: ...Yes, sir!

spans.text: ...Yes, sir!

units.rawText: After hanging up, Python looks behind him. Evelyn, Erwin and his other troopers are waiting silently inside the camp.
units.displayText: After hanging up, Python looks behind him. Evelyn, Erwin and his other troopers are waiting silently inside the camp.

spans.text: After hanging up, Python looks behind him. Evelyn, Erwin and his other troopers are waiting silently inside the camp.

units.rawText: Are they angry? Disappointed? Python can't read their emotions, and the air is stagnant and dead.
units.displayText: Are they angry? Disappointed? Python can't read their emotions, and the air is stagnant and dead.

spans.text: Are they angry? Disappointed? Python can't read their emotions, and the air is stagnant and dead.

units.rawText: Beep—
units.displayText: Beep—

spans.text: Beep—

units.rawText: Just then, a new transmission comes in.
units.displayText: Just then, a new transmission comes in.

spans.text: Just then, a new transmission comes in.

units.rawText: Instructor Python?
units.displayText: Instructor Python?

spans.text: Instructor Python?

units.rawText: Yes, sir! This is Python. Your orders?
units.displayText: Yes, sir! This is Python. Your orders?

spans.text: Yes, sir! This is Python. Your orders?

units.rawText: No need to be so formal. I'm not calling you in my capacity as an officer, but as a private individual. I believe you've already learned of the HQ's decision?
units.displayText: No need to be so formal. I'm not calling you in my capacity as an officer, but as a private individual. I believe you've already learned of the HQ's decision?

spans.text: No need to be so formal. I'm not calling you in my capacity as an officer, but as a private individual. I believe you've already learned of the HQ's decision?

units.rawText: They believe there is no future in mixed human and Doll deployments, but I disagree.
units.displayText: They believe there is no future in mixed human and Doll deployments, but I disagree.

spans.text: They believe there is no future in mixed human and Doll deployments, but I disagree.

units.rawText: I would like you to provide me with the data pertaining to this training camp. You'll receive the relevant paperwork afterwards.
units.displayText: I would like you to provide me with the data pertaining to this training camp. You'll receive the relevant paperwork afterwards.

spans.text: I would like you to provide me with the data pertaining to this training camp. You'll receive the relevant paperwork afterwards.

units.rawText: Understood, sir!
units.displayText: Understood, sir!

spans.text: Understood, sir!

units.rawText: Sir, do you really think...
units.displayText: Sir, do you really think...

spans.text: Sir, do you really think...

units.rawText: Of course. Why else would I be making this call? I think there will be many places where you will be needed in the future. I hope we will be able to stay in contact.
units.displayText: Of course. Why else would I be making this call? I think there will be many places where you will be needed in the future. I hope we will be able to stay in contact.

spans.text: Of course. Why else would I be making this call? I think there will be many places where you will be needed in the future. I hope we will be able to stay in contact.

units.rawText: I will, sir, as long as you need me.
units.displayText: I will, sir, as long as you need me.

spans.text: I will, sir, as long as you need me.

units.rawText: Beep—
units.displayText: Beep—

spans.text: Beep—

units.rawText: The transmission ends again. After pondering for a moment, he plants a cigarette in his mouth before heading back to the camp.
units.displayText: The transmission ends again. After pondering for a moment, he plants a cigarette in his mouth before heading back to the camp.

spans.text: The transmission ends again. After pondering for a moment, he plants a cigarette in his mouth before heading back to the camp.

units.rawText: Sorry, sir...
units.displayText: Sorry, sir...

spans.text: Sorry, sir...

units.rawText: Perk up, even the sparrows outside are louder than you. You lost a competition. It's not the end of the world.
units.displayText: Perk up, even the sparrows outside are louder than you. You lost a competition. It's not the end of the world.

spans.text: Perk up, even the sparrows outside are louder than you. You lost a competition. It's not the end of the world.

units.rawText: But we DID lose.
units.displayText: But we DID lose.

spans.text: But we DID lose.

units.rawText: I am also responsible for this error in judgment.
units.displayText: I am also responsible for this error in judgment.

spans.text: I am also responsible for this error in judgment.

units.rawText: Python eyes them for a long time.
units.displayText: Python eyes them for a long time.

spans.text: Python eyes them for a long time.

units.rawText: You now actually sound like a team that knows how to work together. It was only a competition that you lost this time, but you might not be this lucky on the battlefield.
units.displayText: You now actually sound like a team that knows how to work together. It was only a competition that you lost this time, but you might not be this lucky on the battlefield.

spans.text: You now actually sound like a team that knows how to work together. It was only a competition that you lost this time, but you might not be this lucky on the battlefield.

units.rawText: Pull yourselves together, seedlings.
units.displayText: Pull yourselves together, seedlings.

spans.text: Pull yourselves together, seedlings.

units.rawText: You did very well. Not even veteran troopers might have fared better than you against a pair of Balmungs, which didn't even exist in our intel.
units.displayText: You did very well. Not even veteran troopers might have fared better than you against a pair of Balmungs, which didn't even exist in our intel.

spans.text: You did very well. Not even veteran troopers might have fared better than you against a pair of Balmungs, which didn't even exist in our intel.

units.rawText: Your training will be handled by someone else after this. I hope that the next time I hear of you will be on citations for distinguished service.
units.displayText: Your training will be handled by someone else after this. I hope that the next time I hear of you will be on citations for distinguished service.

spans.text: Your training will be handled by someone else after this. I hope that the next time I hear of you will be on citations for distinguished service.

units.rawText: The soldiers look at Python, uncertain what to say.
units.displayText: The soldiers look at Python, uncertain what to say.

spans.text: The soldiers look at Python, uncertain what to say.

units.rawText: Well?
units.displayText: Well?

spans.text: Well?

units.rawText: <size=44>SIR, YES, SIR!</size>
units.displayText: SIR, YES, SIR!

spans.text: SIR, YES, SIR!

units.rawText: The birds in the forest take flight as the soldiers' shouts echo through the town. It's as though their training had never been interrupted, and the defeat they'd suffered were nothing but an interlude.
units.displayText: The birds in the forest take flight as the soldiers' shouts echo through the town. It's as though their training had never been interrupted, and the defeat they'd suffered were nothing but an interlude.

spans.text: The birds in the forest take flight as the soldiers' shouts echo through the town. It's as though their training had never been interrupted, and the defeat they'd suffered were nothing but an interlude.

units.rawText: Python opens his eyes, which are gleaming with pride.
units.displayText: Python opens his eyes, which are gleaming with pride.

spans.text: Python opens his eyes, which are gleaming with pride.
Morning, Instructor Python.
You're awake.

units.rawText: Ha... It's been a while since anyone called me that. Want to train under me, Commander?
units.displayText: Ha... It's been a while since anyone called me that. Want to train under me, Commander?

spans.text: Ha... It's been a while since anyone called me that. Want to train under me, Commander?

units.rawText: Good morning, Commander.
units.displayText: Good morning, Commander.

spans.text: Good morning, Commander.

units.rawText: How do you feel?
units.displayText: How do you feel?

spans.text: How do you feel?

units.rawText: Like a human who just woke up from a dream, just as you said. What are the results of my neural cloud evaluation?
units.displayText: Like a human who just woke up from a dream, just as you said. What are the results of my neural cloud evaluation?

spans.text: Like a human who just woke up from a dream, just as you said. What are the results of my neural cloud evaluation?

units.rawText: All good. You don't need extra stabilization measures.
units.displayText: All good. You don't need extra stabilization measures.

spans.text: All good. You don't need extra stabilization measures.

units.rawText: Welcome to the Oasis, Python.
units.displayText: Welcome to the Oasis, Python.

spans.text: Welcome to the Oasis, Python.

units.rawText: Thank you, Commander.
units.displayText: Thank you, Commander.

spans.text: Thank you, Commander.

units.rawText: At the firing range of the Oasis.
units.displayText: At the firing range of the Oasis.

spans.text: At the firing range of the Oasis.

units.rawText: Bang, bang, bang!
units.displayText: Bang, bang, bang!

spans.text: Bang, bang, bang!

units.rawText: The low-pitched cracks of consecutive gunshots fills the air, and a few new holes appear on the Doll-shaped target drones sliding back and forth.
units.displayText: The low-pitched cracks of consecutive gunshots fills the air, and a few new holes appear on the Doll-shaped target drones sliding back and forth.

spans.text: The low-pitched cracks of consecutive gunshots fills the air, and a few new holes appear on the Doll-shaped target drones sliding back and forth.

units.rawText: However, none of them are on the bullseye. In fact, very few of them have even hit the outer ring.
units.displayText: However, none of them are on the bullseye. In fact, very few of them have even hit the outer ring.

spans.text: However, none of them are on the bullseye. In fact, very few of them have even hit the outer ring.

units.rawText: Whew...
units.displayText: Whew...

spans.text: Whew...

units.rawText: Evelyn takes off her shooting glasses and earplugs, then begins stripping the gun she's holding.
units.displayText: Evelyn takes off her shooting glasses and earplugs, then begins stripping the gun she's holding.

spans.text: Evelyn takes off her shooting glasses and earplugs, then begins stripping the gun she's holding.

units.rawText: You didn't even hit the target. That's not like you.
units.displayText: You didn't even hit the target. That's not like you.

spans.text: You didn't even hit the target. That's not like you.

units.rawText: Sir, riot police do not shoot to kill. I was practicing non-lethal shots, sir.
units.displayText: Sir, riot police do not shoot to kill. I was practicing non-lethal shots, sir.

spans.text: Sir, riot police do not shoot to kill. I was practicing non-lethal shots, sir.

units.rawText: After giving her reflexive answer, Evelyn stiffens as she realizes who she's talking to.
units.displayText: After giving her reflexive answer, Evelyn stiffens as she realizes who she's talking to.

spans.text: After giving her reflexive answer, Evelyn stiffens as she realizes who she's talking to.

units.rawText: It's been a while, Evelyn.
units.displayText: It's been a while, Evelyn.

spans.text: It's been a while, Evelyn.

units.rawText: In... Instructor?
units.displayText: In... Instructor?

spans.text: In... Instructor?

units.rawText: I'm not your instructor anymore. Call me Python.
units.displayText: I'm not your instructor anymore. Call me Python.

spans.text: I'm not your instructor anymore. Call me Python.

units.rawText: Python smiles and takes out his cigarette case.
units.displayText: Python smiles and takes out his cigarette case.

spans.text: Python smiles and takes out his cigarette case.

units.rawText: Want one?
units.displayText: Want one?

spans.text: Want one?

units.rawText: Erm...
units.displayText: Erm...

spans.text: Erm...

units.rawText: Hehe, it's alright if you don't. Looks like you haven't changed.
units.displayText: Hehe, it's alright if you don't. Looks like you haven't changed.

spans.text: Hehe, it's alright if you don't. Looks like you haven't changed.

units.rawText: You've changed a lot, though. What are you doing here, Instructor?
units.displayText: You've changed a lot, though. What are you doing here, Instructor?

spans.text: You've changed a lot, though. What are you doing here, Instructor?

units.rawText: It's a long story. I just arrived at the Oasis. How about you give me a tour?
units.displayText: It's a long story. I just arrived at the Oasis. How about you give me a tour?

spans.text: It's a long story. I just arrived at the Oasis. How about you give me a tour?

units.rawText: Sir! Er... Of course.
units.displayText: Sir! Er... Of course.

spans.text: Sir! Er... Of course.

units.rawText: As she leads Python out of the range, Evelyn introduces him to the Oasis and tells him about how she's been lately.
units.displayText: As she leads Python out of the range, Evelyn introduces him to the Oasis and tells him about how she's been lately.

spans.text: As she leads Python out of the range, Evelyn introduces him to the Oasis and tells him about how she's been lately.

units.rawText: ...And after that, the Dolls from our unit were hired by the Velvet City PD and became their third riot police platoon.
units.displayText: ...And after that, the Dolls from our unit were hired by the Velvet City PD and became their third riot police platoon.

spans.text: ...And after that, the Dolls from our unit were hired by the Velvet City PD and became their third riot police platoon.

units.rawText: You've all done very well. But given your performance, I thought you'd have gone and served in the army.
units.displayText: You've all done very well. But given your performance, I thought you'd have gone and served in the army.

spans.text: You've all done very well. But given your performance, I thought you'd have gone and served in the army.

units.rawText: It's enough for us to be of use, wherever that may be.
units.displayText: It's enough for us to be of use, wherever that may be.

spans.text: It's enough for us to be of use, wherever that may be.

units.rawText: Wherever it may be... Heh, yeah, Erwin said the exact same thing.
units.displayText: Wherever it may be... Heh, yeah, Erwin said the exact same thing.

spans.text: Wherever it may be... Heh, yeah, Erwin said the exact same thing.

units.rawText: I remember Erwin did end up going and signing up, Instruc... Python.
units.displayText: I remember Erwin did end up going and signing up, Instruc... Python.

spans.text: I remember Erwin did end up going and signing up, Instruc... Python.

units.rawText: You two really haven't changed a bit. You just can't lose that habit, eh? Am I really that scary?
units.displayText: You two really haven't changed a bit. You just can't lose that habit, eh? Am I really that scary?

spans.text: You two really haven't changed a bit. You just can't lose that habit, eh? Am I really that scary?

units.rawText: Sir... Ahem, not really.
units.displayText: Sir... Ahem, not really.

spans.text: Sir... Ahem, not really.

units.rawText: Haha, that doesn't sound convincing at all. Prove it with your actions!
units.displayText: Haha, that doesn't sound convincing at all. Prove it with your actions!

spans.text: Haha, that doesn't sound convincing at all. Prove it with your actions!

units.rawText: Sir! ...That's more like you.
units.displayText: Sir! ...That's more like you.

spans.text: Sir! ...That's more like you.

units.rawText: Well, if you're feeling so nostalgic, why don't we head back to the shooting range and compare notes?
units.displayText: Well, if you're feeling so nostalgic, why don't we head back to the shooting range and compare notes?

spans.text: Well, if you're feeling so nostalgic, why don't we head back to the shooting range and compare notes?

units.rawText: That suits me just fine. Let's go, I'll show you how I've grown during this time.
units.displayText: That suits me just fine. Let's go, I'll show you how I've grown during this time.

spans.text: That suits me just fine. Let's go, I'll show you how I've grown during this time.

units.rawText: Meeting Evelyn's fiery gaze, Python smiles in approval.
units.displayText: Meeting Evelyn's fiery gaze, Python smiles in approval.

spans.text: Meeting Evelyn's fiery gaze, Python smiles in approval.

units.rawText: Looks like my first day in the Oasis is going to be a surprising one, then? Don't disappoint me, Evelyn.
units.displayText: Looks like my first day in the Oasis is going to be a surprising one, then? Don't disappoint me, Evelyn.

spans.text: Looks like my first day in the Oasis is going to be a surprising one, then? Don't disappoint me, Evelyn.

units.rawText: The brilliant sunlight of the Oasis shines down on the artificial grass, and the trampled blades straighten once more, full of life.
units.displayText: The brilliant sunlight of the Oasis shines down on the artificial grass, and the trampled blades straighten once more, full of life.

spans.text: The brilliant sunlight of the Oasis shines down on the artificial grass, and the trampled blades straighten once more, full of life.

units.rawText: Though I'd like to know... Where is Evelyn now?
units.displayText: Though I'd like to know... Where is Evelyn now?

spans.text: Though I'd like to know... Where is Evelyn now?
